title: Staged microcredit releases (milestone unlocks) + enterprise SQ companion for trial-to-contract conversion
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Large up-front trial credit pools are consumed quickly by exploration, causing noisy usage signals and a short-lived evaluation window. Sales and security conversations for trialing enterprise features often stall because trial artifacts don't map to contract/SQ needs.

Proposal: Replace the single lump-sum trial credit with a staged microcredit program that releases small credit allotments when users hit product milestones (first embedding, first successful chat integration, 1st API token issued, 1k tokens generated). Pair this product experiment with an enterprise-facing Security Questionnaire (SQ) companion pack and a one-click contract starter template to shorten the path from trial to paid Dedicated/Private engagements.

Hypothesis: Staged microcredits will (1) increase meaningful engagement metrics (repeat API calls, template adoption), (2) lengthen active evaluation windows, and (3) raise qualified conversion rate for teams that land in sales. The SQ companion reduces friction for enterprise procurement and will increase conversion speed for customers flagged as enterprise by >20%.
acceptance_criteria: Instrumentation: Track cohort-level active days, API calls per user, milestone unlock conversion, and cost per converted customer across variants
Experiment variants: Control (lump-sum credits), Variant A (3-stage microcredit), Variant B (5-stage microcredit + in-app guidance)
Billing hooks: Credits dispensed via billing service; refunds/overages handled per policy; ENG sign-off on 2 new API endpoints
SQ pack: Completed draft of enterprise Security Questionnaire answers + KMS/HSM FAQ approved by Security
Sales artifact: One-click contract starter template and internal playbook for qualifying microcredit-led trials
Legal & Security signoff: Security review completed and documented; legal approves contract starter language
notes: Trade-offs: More complex credit lifecycle increases billing surface area and support load; mitigations include clear telemetry, automated expirations, and runbook for refunds.
Cost control: Microcredits capped per account and tied to observable engagement signals to limit abuse. Finance to provide net burn guardrails before launch.
Rollout plan: Start with self-serve accounts from NA only, 3-week experiment window, then expand to EU if stable. Enterprise trial path exposed via 'Request Enterprise Trial' flag in Console.
